title: The Feigned Death Plan
next_chapter_hook: At the moment everyone confirmed Chen Ji's death, a bizarre laughter echoed from the depths of the Heavenly Eye's core—that laughter was ancient and nonchalant, as if saying: the chess game has just begun.

text.content:
The underground Dragon Vein chamber, candlelight flickering like a bean.

Chen Ji slowly opened his eyes, greeted by dim stone walls. Three days and nights of consciousness drifting had him clawing his way up from the abyss's depths, every inch of skin numb and aching. That chill of standing at death's edge still lingered in his marrow, impossible to shake.

The nightmare from the previous chapter hadn't faded—the variable that shouldn't have appeared in Chapter 700's scroll of fate, like a thorn lodged in the softest part of his heart, shaking his faith in that invisible chessboard for the first time.

He drew a deep breath, suppressing the bone-deep chill in his heart.

There are hands beyond the board. He already knows.

But the game must continue.

A haggard yet joyful face appeared in his vision. Chen Nian's eyes were bloodshot, dark circles under her eyes, lips cracked and peeling, yet her smile was brilliant as someone reborn from disaster.

She had kept vigil for three days and nights.

Warmth bloomed in Chen Ji's heart. He raised his hand to touch her hair but found his arm too weak to lift. He helplessly smiled, his voice hoarse as a rusted bellows: "Silly girl..."

On the other side of the chamber, Dragon Vein power flowed slowly through the stone wall's grooves, like a slumbering giant python breathing in the shadows. The pale golden glow reflected on Chen Ji's pallid face, tracing dragon-scale-like patterns.

Three months. Three full months of preparation, countless calculations and schemes—all for this moment.

Chen Ji closed his eyes, the seventh page of the Tianji Record faintly glowing in the depths of his consciousness. Three months ago, he had calculated that his Heavenly Fate was insufficient to support another major foresight, and the external situation—three major sects vying for supremacy, Demonic Path invasion, the Heavenly Eye's gaze—had driven him into a corner.

dialogue.content: Now that you're awake, stop pretending to be profound. The outside world has already fallen into chaos.

text.content:
Ye Qing pushed aside the chamber curtain and walked in, demonic mist swirling around her, strangely mingling with the Dragon Vein's pure power. Her face had grown thinner than three months ago, a subtle tension visible between her brows.

Three months of fighting side by side, this Holy Sect's Saint had long since ceased to be that cold, aloof collaborator. She had helped mask the Tianji Record's aura, helped arrange the death illusion—every step was breathtaking.

"Go ahead," Chen Ji勉强撑起身子，嘴角勾起一抹淡淡的笑意，"我的葬礼，精彩吗？"

dialogue.content: Su Qingyao... vomited blood on the spot. Her cultivation dropped half a realm.

text.content:
Chen Ji's smile froze on his face.

That cold and stubborn Inner Disciple Senior Fellow, the woman who had come infinitely close to the truth three times and been carefully deflected three times—when she heard his "death news," her cultivation actually regressed.

He noted this down.

This debt would be repaid tenfold in the future—not through harm, but by making her understand that the "waste" she had guarded with her life was worthy of all her trust.

Chen Nian seemed to understand her brother's thoughts, gently gripping his hand, silently conveying strength.

Ye Qing raised an eyebrow, tossing a Jade Slip into Chen Ji's hand. The slip was slightly warm, containing records of all movements among various factions over these three days.

Xuanwu Sect. Han Lie opened seven consecutive days of banquets, vigorously proclaiming "the waste is dead," claiming he would erect a monument at the Tianqing Sect Mountain Gate to publish Chen Ji's "life story" for all to see. The entire Xuanwu Sect celebrated as if years of gloom had finally lifted.

A cold glint flashed in Chen Ji's eyes. Han Lie, you're eager to erect monuments—let me give you a few more days to add to them. When the truth emerges, that inscription will be your epitaph.

Inside the Tianqing Sect. Old Master Ling Yuan personally presided over the "memorial" ceremony, his expression grief-stricken, tears and wailing, lamenting "heaven envying talent." Regardless of closeness, all sect disciples wore white for the funeral—the occasion so grand, unseen for decades.

After reading this record, Chen Ji laughed coldly.

Ling Yuan's acting had improved since three years ago. Had he not known this old master's true colors, he might have been fooled by that benevolent facade.

However—the more you grieve, the more it shows you fear me being alive. Good, keep being afraid.

dialogue.content: Brother, that... the Tianji Record's voice appeared again. It said—it said you deceived everything.

text.content:
Chen Ji's pupils contracted sharply.

The Tianji Record itself gave an evaluation—"deceived everything." This meant the Heavenly Eye's death declaration had been obscured by the "death illusion" formed by Dragon Vein power. That eye transcending all creation had truly wiped his existence from the chessboard for a moment.

However—

Chen Ji's gaze fell on the word "everything," and alarm bells rang in his heart.

Not "deceived heaven" but "deceived everything." This phrasing felt like it was deliberately emphasizing something.

The Dragon Vein's residual energy slowly circulated through his body, repairing the shattered meridians. Each reconnected meridian brought excruciating pain, like ten thousand silver needles piercing flesh simultaneously.

Three days. He needed three days to restore basic mobility, one month to recover seventy percent of his cultivation.

And during this most vulnerable period, the outside world had already descended into chaos—the political landscape of the empire was reshuffling due to the fall of the "Heavenly Fate Bearer," border wars faltered without leadership, various forces took sides, and the old balance collapsed overnight.

And all of this was within his expectations.

choice.prompt: The feigned death is complete, the chess game reversed. Before restoring your strength, you must decide how to make the first move—

choices.description: Disappear without a trace, letting various forces exhaust each other in chaos. Watch the tigers fight from the mountain, wait for them to weaken each other before reaping the harvest.
choices.visible_cost: Losing control over partial situations, some allies may defect due to despair
choices.visible_reward: Internal friction among various forces, maximizing weakening of enemy overall strength
choices.risk_hint: Waiting too long may lead to loss of control, allies drifting away

dialogue.content: Complete concealment? Alright, that's what I'm best at. The Demonic Path mist can hold for three months, enough for your recovery.

text.content: Ye Qing's words made Chen Ji nod slightly. What he needed was precisely time. Time to heal, time for the chess game to ferment, and time for himself—to re-examine that fate chessboard that had been secretly manipulated from the very beginning."Let me catch my breath first." He murmured quietly, "In three days, we'll flip the board again."

choices.description: Secretly contact key allies (Su Qingyao), stabilize the position while offering a fatal bait to enemies—making them think they're safe, when they've actually stepped into an even deeper trap.
choices.visible_cost: Exposing partial whereabouts, risking detection by enemies
choices.visible_reward: Consolidating core ally trust, laying a deadly trap while enemies lower their guard
choices.risk_hint: If Su Qingyao is under surveillance, contact may expose the plan

dialogue.content: But regarding Sister Su... after her cultivation regressed, her condition is poor. Now Ling Yuan has her under house arrest in the Inner Sect under the pretext of "recuperation."

text.content: Ling Yuan! Chen Ji's gaze turned abruptly gloomy. The old sect master acted quickly, controlling Su Qingyao in this way to stabilize the sect while eliminating the greatest variable. However—he had long ago planted a contingency near Ling Yuan. On Su Qingyao, he had personally placed a jade token three months ago. As long as she still breathed, he could find her.

choices.description: Proactively strike first, using the Tianji Record's foresight ability to deliver "prophecy fragments" to major powers, manipulating their next moves—making everyone follow the script he writes.
choices.visible_cost: Massive Heavenly Fate consumption, each foresight costs 500 points, remaining Heavenly Fate only enough for two large-scale forekasts
choices.visible_reward: Completely control the action trajectories of all factions within the next three months, establishing an unshakeable information advantage
choices.risk_hint: If Heavenly Fate drops too low, foresight accuracy will degrade, possible misjudgments may occur, and it will attract the attention of the Eyes of Heavenly Dao

dialogue.content: Manipulating everyone with the Tianji Record? You're insane. In your current state, consuming another thousand points of Heavenly Fate could cause sudden death at any moment.

(The voice of the residual soul guardian echoes in Chen Ji's mind, ancient and indifferent) However... if you're going to do it, go all the way. Give each faction a different "prophecy", making them suspicious of each other, draining each other. Only then can you regain control of the chess game in the shortest time.
Why the rush? The real show is just beginning.

text.content: Chen Ji braces against the stone wall, slowly standing up. His form is still unsteady, but the light in his eyes is as sharp as a drawn sword. Three days of near-death didn't weaken him; instead, his will was tempered into steel. He turns to Ye Qing, his voice calm yet carrying undeniable certainty: "Give me your list of hidden operatives in the Tianqing Sect. It's time to move on Han Lie."

dialogue.content: What do you want to do?

text.content: Chen Ji doesn't answer. His gaze passes over Ye Qing, landing on the dragon vein stone carved with runes in the corner of the secret chamber. Three months ago, he used the Tianji Record to calculate 3,726 possibilities, finally choosing this path—feigning death. Among the 3,726 calculations, this was the only path that could let him achieve three goals simultaneously: evading the Eyes of Heavenly Dao, eliminating threats from internal traitors, and reshuffling the board during the world's upheaval.

Chen Nian suddenly whispers, "Brother, while I was unconscious... I saw that scene again. That unexpected variable that shouldn't appear—it... it seemed to be laughing." Chen Ji's spine instantly tenses. He walks quickly to Chen Nian, placing his hands on her shoulders, his voice low but with undeniable seriousness: "What was it laughing at? Mocking us, or..."

dialogue.content: I don't know... but that smile terrified me. The kind of fear that's worse than anger.

text.content: The secret chamber falls into brief silence. The dragon vein's light flows silently across the walls, while Ye Qing's Demonic Path mist intertwines with the dragon vein's power, forming a barrier in the air barely visible to the naked eye. Chen Ji remains silent for a long time. He recalls what Mo Xiansheng said: "The more complete the Tianji Record, the stronger fate's deadly backlash." The moment he obtained the seventh page, he knew this day would not be far off. But he never expected it to arrive so violently.

Chen Nian's fingers tightly grip Chen Ji's sleeve, her knuckles white from the force. She was taken by the Holy Sect as a child, imprisoned for over a decade as the "Heavenly Fate Key," her body already riddled with wounds. Three months ago, Chen Ji fought with everything he had to rescue her, thinking she could finally live a peaceful life, but now— She stands once again at the storm's center of destiny. Chen Ji reaches out, gently covering her hand with his. His hand is still cold, but that touch conveys an invisible warmth: "Nian Nian, don't be afraid. No matter who stands behind that chessboard, I'll drag them out."

Just then, the formation outside the secret chamber suddenly trembles—a signal that the outer warning array has been triggered. Ye Qing's expression sharpens: "Someone is approaching this area. It's someone from the Tianqing Sect... no, the aura is very unfamiliar, not from the three major sects." A sharp light flashes in Chen Ji's eyes. The three major sects are currently busy dividing the power vacuum left behind by his "death," so no outsider should know about this hidden location. Unless—someone knew from the beginning that he was laying plans.

choice.prompt: Abnormal formation fluctuation, the visitor means trouble. You decide—

choices.description: Take advantage of the intruder not knowing the true extent of this location, proactively attack and subdue the visitor. Interrogate them about their identity and purpose, eliminate them if necessary to prevent future trouble.
choices.visible_cost: In your current severely injured state, forcefully engaging may worsen your injuries and deplete the remaining combat power reserves
choices.visible_reward: Obtain crucial intelligence, intimidate potential enemies, and transform a passive situation into an intelligence advantage.
choices.risk_hint: If the visitor's strength far exceeds expectations, the hiding place may be exposed.

dialogue.content: Since you've come, don't leave. Nian Nian, protect yourself well.

text.content: Chen Ji drew a black chess piece from his chest—the "Tianji Seed," one of his last trump cards, capable of suppressing the target's combat power by thirty percent for the time it takes an incense stick to burn. His figure flickered and vanished into the shadows. Ye Qing followed closely behind, demonic path mist spreading silently to shroud the entire secret chamber area. A hunt is about to begin.

choices.description: Have Ye Qing conceal your presence with mist. You and Chen Nian hide in the deepest hidden space within the Dragon Vein. Observe the visitor's identity and purpose through the formation, and act according to circumstances.
choices.visible_cost: If the visitor's strength is sufficiently powerful, they might directly destroy the formation, leaving you without an escape route.
choices.visible_reward: Do not reveal your trump cards. Obtain complete intelligence first, then make a decision to minimize risk.
choices.risk_hint: The hidden space deep within the Dragon Vein is cramped and narrow, and will accelerate the consumption of your Heavenly Fate value.

dialogue.content: Hide well and don't move. Let me meet this uninvited guest.

text.content: Ye Qing's figure dissolved into the mist, vanishing in an instant at the secret chamber entrance. Chen Ji gripped Chen Nian's hand with one hand, pressing the other against the Dragon Vein stone. The stone wall silently cracked open, revealing a narrow passage barely wide enough for two people to squeeze through sideways. Without hesitation, he pulled Chen Nian inside. Deep within the passage, Dragon Vein energy thickened almost into tangible substance, warm qi enveloping them like a dormant dragon gently cradling them in its palm.

choices.description: Walk out of the secret chamber and confront the visitor directly. Appearing before enemies as a "dead" person creates psychological impact far beyond any disguise—causing the opponent to reveal weaknesses in extreme shock.
choices.visible_cost: Completely expose your survival status. If the visitor is an enemy, you will become the target of all attacks, and the Heavenly Eye may gaze upon you again.
choices.visible_reward: Absolute psychological domination. Any enemy seeing you in that instant will fall into chaos, enough to disrupt all forces' arrangements in a short time.
choices.risk_hint: You are currently severely injured and not yet healed. If the opponent is stronger than you, you will have no ability to fight back.

dialogue.content: No need to hide. Since it wants to watch a show, I will perform for it.

text.content: Chen Ji pushed open the stone wall and strode out of the secret chamber. His face was pale as paper, his body swaying, but those eyes burned bright with intensity. He stood there at the entrance of the Dragon Vein secret chamber, his pallid features flickering in the golden light like a specter emerging from a coffin. Chen Nian tried to grab him, but Ye Qing stopped her with a look—Ye Qing's eyes held a flash of understanding. What Chen Ji was about to do required no interference.

In the depths of the mist, a figure gradually materialized.

The visitor wore a gray cloth robe, his features utterly unremarkable, the kind of face that would never draw attention in a crowd. But when those eyes met Chen Ji's, his pupils contracted sharply—

Those were eyes with absolutely no emotional fluctuation. Hollow, cold, like two bottomless dry wells reflecting the sun, moon, and stars, yet revealing no human sentiment whatsoever.

This is not a person. This is a vessel for some kind of will.

dialogue.content: (The gray-robed figure spoke, his voice completely devoid of起伏, like a heavenly verdict) Chen Ji. Holder of the seventh page of the Tianji Record. Your death record has been filed.

text.content:
Filed.

These two words struck Chen Ji's heart like a heavy hammer. The Heavenly Eye did not personally intervene, merely dispatching a vessel to "file" him—what does this mean? Does it mean it simply doesn't believe he could die? Or does it mean it's waiting for a better opportunity?

Chen Ji's heart skipped a beat.

That unexpected variable—the thing from Chen Nian's prophecy that filled him with bone-deep chill—right now, could it be watching him through those hollow eyes?
